english: 23-32. In every house, the wonderful stories of the doings (of the Lord) were sung. Man-made paintings were seen on the walls of the palaces. No other news except that of the stories of Hari was heard. Due to the fear of that king, deer fat with plenty of flesh were not killed by hunters. They roamed about as they pleased in forests. Due to the fear of that king neither fish, nor cranes, nor boars were killed by anyone even if he was an eater of fish and meat. Men were not sonless anywhere in the kingdom of Amitrajit.
